How much is a used Steam Deck worth?

The Steam Deck has two generations and several storage sizes. The difference between them is bigger than most listings make clear.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The LCD model (2022) came with 64 GB, 256 GB or 512 GB. The OLED model (2023) has a larger, brighter screen and comes with 512 GB or 1 TB. The storage is shown in Settings, System. The OLED is worth noticeably more than the LCD.

What decides the price

  • Generation: OLED versus LCD.
  • Storage: the 64 GB LCD model sells for least. An upgraded SSD can add a little, but buyers pay mostly for the original specification.
  • Sticks and screen: drift, scratches and dead pixels.
  • Case and charger: the original carrying case and the 45 W charger.

Check before you buy

  • Check the model and storage in Settings, System.
  • Test both sticks and the trackpads.
  • Look for dead pixels on a white background.
  • The seller should log out of Steam and reset the device.

Where it sells best

Sells well on eBay and Vinted. Ship it in its case inside a padded box.

Today's price

Prices for a used Steam Deck change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. Questions

How much is a used Steam Deck worth?

It depends on LCD or OLED, storage, screen and stick drift. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Valve Steam Deck" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Is an LCD Steam Deck still worth buying to resell?

Yes, if the price is right: it is still in demand as a cheaper handheld PC. Compare only with LCD models of the same storage.

Does an SSD upgrade raise the price?

A little. Most buyers value the original model and storage, so do not expect to recover the cost of the upgrade.
